banned.claim: Guilt-free or healthy candy that helps you burn fat.
banned.why: Banned health/fat-burning claim - false and unsupportable for a candy product.

banned.claim: Boosts immunity or supports your health.
banned.why: Banned unqualified health/immunity claim for a food product.
Unqualified 'detox' is a banned health claim.
Nutrient-content claim must match the actual label; no label data provided to support it.
'Natural' and 'clean' are vague, risky headline claims not substantiated on-site.
